blocks.text: Check out this page for live updates on Miss Grand International 2026 Angelica Lopez of the Philippines is off to a promising start as she entered the Top 25 of the Miss Grand International 2026 pageant held in Bangkok, Thailand on Saturday, Oct. 10. The announcement came after the show’s grand opening segment, where all 78 delegates introduced themselves in sparkling blue ensembles. Lopez alongside delegates from Pakistan, Thailand, and Hongkong were also awarded the Best National Costume. The Philippine bet showcased the “mangkukulam” (witch) in her national costume.
